intent_snapshot.goal: README.md and README.zh-CN.md describe unattended batches the way the current runtime runs them, so no reader expects a retired serial runner, a shared imm-batch/<slug> branch or a same-Host serial fallback (#347; the user confirmed widening from the zh §1 table to every retired serial-batch statement in both READMEs). Current facts to state, sourced from README.md:563-569 and code: every batch uses runtime-created Lanes and capacity 1 runs one Lane at a time; child worktrees live under the Git common directory at imm/worktrees/<slug>/<task_id> (plugins/immune-brain/runtime/unattended/batch_worktrees.ts:30) on branch imm-lane/<slug>/<task_id> (batch_worktrees.ts:41); Parent progress is kept on refs/heads/imm/<slug> (plugins/immune-brain/runtime/unattended/batch_ref.ts:30); without a supervised Executor the Parent reports a blocker, not a coordinator-execution fallback. Delegated choices: (1) edited zh passages: the lead paragraph and §1 of 无人值守批次运行 (README.zh-CN.md:564, :568-575; the serial-vs-parallel table becomes the five bullets of README.md §1), the §3 lead (:585, 'at every capacity'), and the serial claims at :17, :121, :547 and the FAQ answer at :706, which also gains README.md:692's sentence that a parked run waits indefinitely; (2) edited en passages: README.md:17, :121, :544 and the FAQ answer at :692 stop saying 'default serial', 'single-branch serial execution' or 'serially on one batch branch' and instead say capacity 1 runs one Lane at a time and the Parent ref is fast-forwarded; (3) wording that names retired serial artifacts as retired (README.md:569 'v1 serial records', 'the serial runner ... removed') stays; the mermaid label imm-lane/... and the lane-steward role stay; any other zh/en prose difference is out of scope; (4) a guard case in tests/pi-only-current-contracts.test.ts pins the retired phrases out.

acceptance.assertion: tests/pi-only-current-contracts.test.ts passes, including a new case asserting that: neither README.md nor README.zh-CN.md contains `imm-batch/`, 'single-branch serial', 'serially on one batch branch' or 'Runs serially by default'; README.zh-CN.md contains none of 串行批次, 单分支串行, 单工作区串行, 在一个 batch 分支上串行 or 在同一 Host 串行执行; and README.zh-CN.md contains both `imm/worktrees/<slug>/<task_id>` and `refs/heads/imm/<slug>`. The file's existing assertions, including the ADR 0031 retired-skill-name guard, still pass.
tests/role-prompt-bridge.test.ts, which also reads README.zh-CN.md, still passes.
